objective: Implement and test every open issue in refactory-dsh, in ranked order, verified against the circle_packing + annealing_pack running example
rule: Do not stop while any item below is not 'done'. test_work_complete.py fails otherwise, and it requires every item to name its issue, its verification command, and (once done) the evidence observed.
ordered_by: correctness first, then the runtime, then the API, then independent tracks, then the generators, then the future work

items.title: History access, and refuse a proposal that reproduces an existing state (E-duplicate)
items.why: A real bug: duplicates are silently dropped by step(), so batch slots are lost and the run overstates what it tried. Also the prerequisite for the OuterLoop run handle.
items.evidence: 173 passed. tests/test_history.py is new (12 tests): read_run from report.json, the per-candidate fallback for a run with no report, truncation reported, find_runs newest-first and excluding the current run, the context's history/tried/prior_runs, and the prompt carrying both new sections. E-duplicate is refused at the optimizer layer (test_optim.py, 4 new tests) and asserted never to reach step()'s defensive path (attempt == 0), so the slot is refused at the right layer. A real random-optimizer run on circle_packing/adaptive left coded refusals in rejections.jsonl with no lost slot. Reproduce: pytest refactory/tests/test_history.py refactory/tests/test_optim.py -q

items.title: str knobs are invisible to the random optimizer and to init's sweep
items.why: Closes the 'declared = optimizable' guarantee, which is the rule the whole seam rests on.
items.evidence: 185 passed. tests/test_str_knobs.py is new (12 tests): an open str knob is sampled by textual mutation and never returns the current value; a str knob with declared values picks one of them; every kind (int, float, bool, str, enum) returns a sample; values validation rejects a non-str kind; the spec round-trips values; the random optimizer proposes string knobs across 40 seeds; the starting sweep includes them; a narrow optimizer is warned about by name at init and reported in knob_coverage; describe() names values and range separately and no longer has an overloaded bounds. A real run on circle_packing/adaptive reports knob_coverage.unreachable == [] and leaves the example test green. Reproduce: pytest refactory/tests/test_str_knobs.py refactory/tests/test_example.py -q

items.title: Path-aware evaluation integrity, and the validator's rules stated in the optimizer prompt
items.why: The metric guard is weaker than designed (graph-wide, not path-aware), and every run wastes attempts rediscovering V1-V10.
items.evidence: 218 passed. tests/test_integrity.py is new (12 tests): on_path_nodes excludes a region that cannot reach a terminal; a producer off every path no longer satisfies fact_produced (and V3 does not fire, so it fails on the path); a producer on a path satisfies it; a read satisfied only off-path is refused as V6; the running example's seed still validates. The rules reach the optimizer: a test asserts every code the validator emits appears in RULES and vice versa (AST-parsed, both directions), and that the prompt states V4-V10. summarise_reasons is tested to put the mode-declared rule first and to state the collapsed count. A real autoresearch run used the new prompt: 0 refusals, and its diagnosis cited a previous run's result. Reproduce: pytest refactory/tests/test_integrity.py -q

items.title: Mode authoring surface: declared memory with retention, ports, declared surface
items.why: Cross-run priors need somewhere declared to live; the GUI needs to know what a mode publishes.
items.evidence: 218 passed. tests/test_declarations.py is new (17 tests): memory namespace/kind/retention validation, port validation, spec round trips, a run-scoped memory is invisible to another run while a project-scoped one is visible, forget_run_scoped names what it dropped and is quiet the second time, a project memory survives it, kinds cannot be misused, an undeclared namespace is refused, a map keeps keys. V11 refuses a declared port no node on a path writes and accepts one that is written; ports and memory travel in the state and round trip; the report names both and the run records which ports it produced. Reproduce: pytest refactory/tests/test_declarations.py -q

items.title: Run durability: artifact schema version, and resume from an append-only log
items.why: A crash loses the run, and unversioned artifacts make an old report read as current.
items.evidence: 213 passed. tests/test_durability.py is new (13 tests): run.json records the layout version; a different version is refused; a run predating versioning is refused rather than guessed; an unreadable sibling is skipped as a prior; the journal records start/candidate/score/epoch_open/epoch_end; resume reproduces an uninterrupted run exactly (best score, evaluations, epochs completed and the whole leaderboard) from three crash points -- before any epoch, between epochs, and from the middle of one; resume does not re-evaluate a scored candidate; a torn final line is ignored; the epoch is not counted twice. Reproduce: pytest refactory/tests/test_durability.py -q

items.title: Lower the mode state dict to refactory's IR and run it on DSH
items.why: The stated target: DSH is the runtime, the Python walker is a debug runtime.
items.evidence: 256 passed, 6 skipped. tests/test_lowering.py (16) + tests/test_runner.py (12) + tests/test_equivalence.py (6, marked integration). The equivalence suite passes in full with --run-integration (62s): the spine's own validateGraph accepts the lowered ir; a mode scores the same on DSH as with the walker; the facts match field by field (circles, seed_score, best_score, spent); a node that lies about its facts is refused on the DSH path; and a one-epoch loop with --evaluator dsh reaches the same best score as the walker. Reproduce: pytest refactory/tests/test_equivalence.py -q --run-integration

items.title: Two extension points (Optimizer, OuterLoop) plus all 13 SRF strategies ported
items.why: The search research surface. The abstraction is proven by the ports, not by tests of the abstraction.
items.evidence: 288 passed, 6 skipped. tests/test_outerloop.py (13) covers the seam: a type-1 proposer plugs into the default loop and improves the mode; Run exposes every primitive; evaluating past the budget is refused; attempt spends nothing while evaluate spends one; a strategy can override parent selection, how often it asks, acceptance, archiving and stopping; and a custom control flow cannot get an invalid edit evaluated. tests/test_strategies.py (24) tests each of the 13 ports on its defining behaviour, asserts the port count, and covers registration. A real run of --strategy reflective --optimizer autoresearch logged mutate/mutate/merge and took circle_packing 0.875 -> 1.04. Reproduce: pytest refactory/tests/test_outerloop.py refactory/tests/test_strategies.py -q

items.title: Package lifecycle: import, add, remove, enable/disable; workspace root; provenance and trust
items.why: A regression against the deleted glue, and generated packages currently land in the source tree.
items.evidence: 315 passed. tests/test_package_lifecycle.py is new (27 tests): the workspace is not the install tree; a workspace package is discovered, is importable by its normal path, and is reported by the catalogue with where it lives; a name in both roots is refused; add copies, records provenance and trust, refuses a clash, renames with --as, refuses a non-package; import takes a path or refuses a non-path; remove deletes a workspace package, refuses an installed one as read-only, refuses to break a dependent and allows --force; verify reports a missing requirement and a mode whose call does not resolve, and is clean for every installed package; the CLI verbs add, remove, verify, smoke, enable, disable all work and a refusal is a message not a traceback; generated packages are marked. create-mode now writes into the workspace, and annealing_pack declares requires=('circle_packing',). Reproduce: pytest refactory/tests/test_package_lifecycle.py -q

items.title: Generated packages execute as trusted code
items.why: create-mode imports and runs model-written Python with no isolation; the old system sandboxed candidates.
items.evidence: 335 passed. tests/test_sandbox.py is new (20 tests): a well-formed package passes the AST check; it catches a file that does not parse, a missing manifest, a mode with no score(), and a call to eval(); it does not execute anything (a package that raises on import still passes); the environment is an allowlist with secrets dropped and a test asserts the real DEEPSEEK_API_KEY is not visible to a sandboxed run; HOME is redirected; a run past its time limit is killed; a sandboxed run returns its JSON payload; the sandboxed verification reports a broken mode and imports out of process; a sandboxed smoke scores a real mode; promotion is explicit and recorded. create-mode now validates by AST plus a subprocess, never importing what it generated, and its smoke run is sandboxed. Reproduce: pytest refactory/tests/test_sandbox.py -q

items.title: Optimizer-facing signals: author priors, refusal findings, block signals, no-op as convergence
items.why: Makes the search better; none of it makes it correct, which is why it follows the correctness work.
items.evidence: 348 passed. tests/test_signals.py is new (13 tests): the mode states guidance and preferred edits and the prompt carries both; a mode with none says so rather than showing nothing; the sampler proposes the preferred operations and still covers the catalogue; an advisory block declares score_effect=none, an unknown tier is refused, and it travels in the state; a dominant refusal is reported as a finding about the catalogue and appears in report.md; a clean run invents no finding; running out of ideas is reported as surface_exhausted with the detail in markdown; a productive run reports no convergence; the report carries attempts per candidate and why that k; and k rises past the configured value on a refusal-heavy batch. A real autoresearch run echoed the guidance in its diagnosis and reached 1.08 with zero refusals. Reproduce: pytest refactory/tests/test_signals.py -q

items.title: Run and visualise the outer loop from the GUI, with the loop staying Pythonic
items.why: A user must be able to start a run and read what came out without a terminal.

items.title: create-mode: survey, strategy, design review, then emit
items.why: It is a stub next to create-v2: no research, no strategy, no design review.
items.evidence: 362 passed. tests/test_create.py gains 14 tests: the survey names what already exists (both installed modes appear); the strategy prompt carries the survey, the JSON schema and the gate-vs-op distinction; the design prompt carries the chosen approach; a coherent design passes review; review refuses a single-approach choice, a missing chosen/why/score, a closest_existing that is not installed, a design with no knobs, a declared graph that does not hold together (V2), a gate declared with a call instead of an evaluator, and an answer that is not JSON; review accepts 'none'; the gate reloops then fails loudly with its reasons; a bad design is retried with its reasons in the retry prompt. A real create run considered three approaches and named annealing_pack/anneal as closest, passed review, and produced phase_pack/countup smoke-scoring 5.0. Reproduce: pytest refactory/tests/test_create.py -q

items.title: design-v2: the third meta-mode, emitting software rather than a package
items.why: A named deliverable of the original product with no replacement.
items.evidence: 379 passed. tests/test_edit_design.py: the design graph is a different shape (no register, no smoke); its state validates with all calls resolved; designing needs a check and refuses without one; the artifact lands beside the workspace, not in it; the check gate proceeds when the artifact runs and reloops with what the check said when it does not; the check runs without the real credentials; a full run with a fake model produces a checked artifact; a design that never passes fails loudly. A real run designed a wordcount tool: one file, its declared check passed, 6 graph steps, 70s. Reproduce: pytest refactory/tests/test_edit_design.py -q

items.title: Edit an existing mode from a brief, with provenance and a before/after score
items.why: The honest middle path between creating from scratch and hoping a random edit lands.
items.evidence: 379 passed. tests/test_edit_design.py (17 tests): EditMode is the create graph with a different intent; prepare hands the model the source being revised and records revision_of; a revision needs a mode; a revision produces a package and reports before and after scores; provenance records what it came from; a regression is refused by default and allowed with allow_regression; a revision of a mode that does not run is refused. A real run revised circle_packing/adaptive to add a stall-restart: 0.875 -> 0.99, regressed false, three files. Reproduce: pytest refactory/tests/test_edit_design.py -q

items.title: Stretch: express the outer loop as a refactory mode
items.why: Future work, but the OuterLoop surface is chosen so this is a lowering rather than a rewrite.
